item.title: Done Deal: Jemal Residence at 135 Nottingham
item.description: Norman and Morris Jemal, developer Douglas Jemal’s sons, sold 135 Nottingham Terrace yesterday. The property was listed at the end of January with a $2.5 million asking price, went pending in one day, and sold for $2.75 million. The buyer, aptly named 135 Nottingham LLC, was registered on February 11 with a 50 Fountain Plaza, suite 1700, offices for law firm Lippes Mathias.
